mentions.name: NoNews
mentions.description: This app is a bilingual (EN/ZH) signal radar that reads official and first-party feeds directly (Federal Reserve, SEC, ECB, DOJ, CFTC, ArXiv, GitHub releases, GDELT), clusters duplicate coverage into a single event card, and measures how far ahead of mainstream coverage each signal lands. Every card links back to the original source with no full-text republication, and lead-time stats accumulate into a monthly index.
mentions.source_excerpt: NoNews (https://nonews.io) — a signal radar for Chinese-speaking readers (bilingual EN/ZH).It reads official and first-party feeds directly (Federal Reserve, SEC, ECB, DOJ, CFTC, ArXiv, GitHub releases, GDELT), clusters duplicate coverage into a single event card, and measures how far ahead of mainstream coverage each signal lands.
